su2-boundary.scope: All three nonzero-order slots of C0 star C2 = Qpert w, including bare ghosts, both rotations and field/jet counts; terms above order two vanish by b-degree.

product-kernels.scope: The one-loop and all three two-loop closed forest moments with zero external jet orders; does not regenerate the seven-loop tables.

hessian-bridge.scope: Every ordered traceless-Cartan Hessian entry at N=3,4 and 0 <= k <= 16. The all-degree proof is analytic.

effective-ideals.scope: Magnetic 3-by-3 determinant Euler relation and perturbative evaluation; finite-circle Euler identity at Nc=2,3. Superpotentials are inputs.

global-ads.scope: Global polynomial Jacobian identity and zero-scale critical-point test in the constrained effective model.

sqcd-f-terms.scope: All 15 six-by-six Pfaffian derivatives, origin, heavy-field elimination, ADS differential and localized unit primitive.

fundamental-triangle.scope: Both Wick signs, both triangle factors and the source-normalized anomaly/Higgs cancellation; no instanton amplitude.

su5-invariants.scope: Classical adjoint trace quotient, its Groebner basis, square and cube; does not prove quantum full-ring matching.

kutasov-branches.scope: Deformed trace polynomials, branch multiplicities and electric/magnetic trace map in the specified presentation.

quotient-hypothesis.scope: Four-dimensional matrix counterexample to strengthening the homotopy identity to automatic contraction on ker L / im L; not a gauge theory.

moduli-integrals.scope: The separated position/size integral pi^2/90 and named auxiliary moments. The script's factor 36 is not the physical-profile factor 9 in section 10.

wilson-moments.scope: Normalized straight-line angular measure, character moments and rational lower bound on the Wilson insertion.

wilson-closed.scope: Closed angular expression and the strengthened positive lower bound for the straight Wilson line alone.

sw-geometry.scope: Curve discriminants, inverse period through the second coefficient and E6 coordinate change; geometry, not microscopic Q-cohomology.

massless-source.scope: The complete 142-by-39 rational tree matrix, four paired color evaluations, restricted triangle rank, massive-family F-equations, pole residue, and both signed cancellations in the two-parameter specialization differential. The single-instanton amplitude remains uncomputed.

scalar-saturation.scope: Full determinant and circle ideal saturations at sizes two and three, all 15 Pfaffian minors and exterior-degree pivots, scale substitution, and the length-two local quotient with its explicit primitive.

translation-jets.scope: Full SU(2) ghost-number-two basic jet matrices at spins 2 through 16, their translation generators, and the nonzero closed cubic jets. The all-spin simple-algebra recurrence is analytic. Also checks N=4 two-point descendant coefficients for p=2,3,4 and k=0 through 6.
